criteria.title: Shadow AI is inventoried
criteria.statement: The GenAI apps the pilot users reach (approved or not) show in the AI asset inventory, with who uses them and how much.
criteria.attest: In the AI asset inventory, the GenAI apps the pilot devices used (the traffic generator sends GenAI traffic) are listed with their users. Screenshot the inventory.

criteria.title: Models, AI services and MCP servers in the customer's cloud are found
criteria.statement: With the customer's test cloud account connected, AI-SPM finds the models, AI services, data stores, agents and MCP servers in it.
criteria.attest: The connected cloud account's AI assets are listed (models, AI services, MCP servers or agents). Screenshot the list with the account named.

criteria.title: Risky AI exposures are flagged with a fix
criteria.statement: Misconfigurations such as a publicly reachable model endpoint, an over-permissioned agent or sensitive data in a training store are flagged, rated, and come with remediation steps.
criteria.attest: At least one AI risk finding is shown with its severity and remediation. Screenshot it.

criteria.title: AI governance is reported against a framework
criteria.statement: Posture is mapped to an AI framework the customer cares about (NIST AI RMF, EU AI Act or ISO 42001), with a report usable as audit evidence.
criteria.attest: A compliance view or report for the customer's chosen framework is produced. Attach it or a screenshot.
